import_kelm_data: run the script to import a KELM JSONL file into a MongoDB collection
extract_entities_from_hypotheses: extract Wikidata Q-prefixed entities from valid_hypotheses triples in each JSONL instance
extract_relations_from_hypotheses: extract relation identifiers from valid_hypotheses triples in each JSONL instance
batch_insert_to_mongodb: batch insert parsed KELM instances into MongoDB in groups of 5000 documents
use_kelmmongo_client: use the KELMMongo client to connect to and close a MongoDB collection
